course_name_original: Construction of Production Machines and Robots
course_name_en: Construction of Production Machines and Robots

learning_outcomes.text: The student is introduced to classification of production machines, construction of basic types of machine tools and forming machines and their typical designs.
The student learns about the main types of industrial robots and manipulators (stationary, mobile and service) and their incorporation into robotized systems (cells, lines).
Acquire basic knowledge on construction of common types of production machines and industrial robots.

syllabus_topics: Machine tools – classification, construction parameters, technological possibilities
Main parts and constructional nodes and komponents of machine tools, machining centres and single-purpose machine tools.
Machine tools – construction of turning, drilling and boring machines
Machine tools – construction of milling, planning and broaching machines
Machine tools – construction of machining centres
Forming machines – classification, construction parameters, technological possibilities
Forming machines – construction of presses
Forming machines – construction of machine hammers
Industrial robots and manipulators – definitions of terms, main problems of robotization
Examples of typical industrial robots
Construction of stationary industrial robots
Introduction to control and programming of industrial robots
Types and construction of mobile robots
Introductory seminar. Excursion to heavy laboratory of ÚVSSR
Safety training, specification of semester works
Machine tools practicum
Machine tools practicum
Technology of Virtual Reality in construction of Machine Tools
Technology of Virtual Reality in construction of Machine Tools
Automation and Sensors in construction of Machine Tools
Automation and Sensors in construction of Machine Tools
Production systems practicum
Production systems practicum
Industrial robots – on-line programming
Industrial robots – off-line programming, design of robotic workplaces
Test and award of graded course-unit credit

assessment_methods.method: Meet the requirements relating to the exercise

assessment_rules: Graded credit is awarded on the basis of a test (the subject matter of the lectures) and meeting the requirements relating to the exercise. Attendance at lectures is not obligatory, yet recommended. Seminars are obligatory. Graded course-unit credit is awarded on the basis of a test. Absence from seminars must be excused and can be substituted for by presentation of a report.
